review_evidence: README identifies a complete Lean 4 + mathlib formalization of the Feit-Thompson Odd Order Theorem, with an axiom-clean theorem that every finite group of odd order is solvable.

The 1,706 primary Lean files form a large finite-group-theory library covering the Feit-Thompson proof, character theory, modular representation theory, local analysis, and full result-by-result formalizations of several source texts and cited papers.

The repository reports that all Lean sources are sorry-free and every numbered result of the three principal books has been formalized; no current-primary subtree can be discarded without losing unique proof/search content.
summary: Retain the full Odd Order/Feit-Thompson formalization and its extensive supporting finite-group theory library.
